score_reasons.gameplay: Objective recovery and ranged pressure created actual decisions, but both runs ended while navigating with very limited successful aiming. Combat depth and late mission are unproven.
score_reasons.presentation: Cohesive rain, teal/amber lighting, large typography and clean terminal screens; repeated blocky robots and cover geometry remain visibly prototype-like.
score_reasons.usability: Move, map, reload, vault, recovery and fallback look were taught. Map helped plan/correct routes. Reach boundary caused several failed holds under damage; movement into pillars/walls needed correction.
score_reasons.readability: Readable objective distances, health/ammo and recovery confirmations. Multiple simultaneous contextual panels, minimap, damage arrows and enemy status compete for attention; enemy optic aim remained difficult in these batches.
score_reasons.AAA_readiness: Limited observed encounter/content range, coarse repeated geometry and incomplete end-to-end coverage. No AAA certification implied.
